FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
The handbook prepares people to drive passenger vehicles safely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
If the handbook conflicts with legislation, the legislation controls. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
A person with a disability who needs a special examination accommodation should arrange a DMV appointment before visiting. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A01
An applicant may request an audio examination delivered through headphones. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A01
The bicycle definition includes vehicles propelled entirely by a person using foot pedals. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A01
An electric bicycle meets this definition if it has operable pedals, two or three wheels, an electric motor rated below 750 watts, and a top speed below 20 mph using only that motor on level pavement with a 170-pound rider. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A01
A bike box reserves space at the front of an intersection traffic lane so cyclists can turn and position themselves visibly ahead of traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A01
A Blue Certificate is a driver education certificate. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A01
For motor-vehicle-law purposes, conviction includes a guilty finding, a guilty plea, or forfeiting a bail bond. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A01
A divided highway separates its roadways with a space, barrier, or marked dividing area constructed to impede vehicle traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A01
A Driving Privilege Card permits driving but cannot serve as valid identification. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A01
A driver is anyone exercising actual physical control over a motor vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0011]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A02
A valid driver education certificate documents successful completion of a course approved by the Delaware Department of Education and must satisfy that department’s criteria. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A02
The highway definition covers the full width within the boundaries of a road open to public vehicle traffic, excluding privately or institutionally owned roads. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A02
A highway-rail intersection is the shared area where a highway meets or crosses railroad tracks. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A02
An intersection is the shared area where at least two highways meet, even when neither crosses the other. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A02
A driver license grants its holder the privilege of operating a motor vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A02
In the handbook, must identifies a legally required action or practice. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A03
In the handbook, should identifies a recommendation that the law does not require. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A03
The roadway is the highway portion designed, improved, or ordinarily used for vehicle travel, without its shoulder. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0013]

Misconceptions: A handbook recommendation and a legal requirement have different force; use the cited must and should definitions.
Mnemonics: Use “must means mandatory” as an authored recall cue for the cited definition.
Glossary: Highway covers the road boundary area; roadway excludes the shoulder, as the cited definitions explain.
Dynamic facts: Agency contact details and online services need fresh verification and are withheld from stable knowledge.
